書櫃中放著各式各樣的書籍，其中有一本書被塞到了書櫃角落，是否要把它拿出來？: The shelves hold all kinds of books. One has been tucked away in a corner. Would you like to take it out?
書名：花藝百科。序：迷香溫室，不知何時所建，不知何人所有，只知溫室之花來自各方，: Title: Encyclopedia of Flowers. Preface: No one knows when Fragrant Greenhouse was built or who owns it. Flowers from every corner of the world grow and bloom together here. In time, they become Flower Spirits. These spirits test visitors, and only those who pass may enter this sacred place.
要閱讀哪一章節？: Which chapter would you like to read?
暘蕊花，來自東方的花，盛開於拂曉之際，吸收日出的第一縷曙光才會綻放。需要適量澆水: The Dawn Blossom comes from the east. It blooms at daybreak, opening only after absorbing the first rays of the rising sun. It needs moderate watering and weeding.
雪萼蘭，來自北方的花，傳說唯有北風凜冽時才會開花，凋謝後會結成冰晶。需要少量澆水: The Snow Orchid comes from the north. It is said to bloom only in a bitter north wind, turning into ice crystals when it withers. It needs a little watering and weeding, and moderate pest removal.
暮海蓓，來自西方的花，夜幕低垂時才會慢慢綻放，期內飽含大量水分，花朵綻放猶如水波: The Twilight Bud comes from the west. Full of moisture, it slowly opens at nightfall, its petals rippling like water. It needs plenty of watering and a little pest removal.
炎羽芙，來自南方的花，花開時宛如羽焰爆散，據說能燃盡邪惡之氣。少量除蟲及大量除草: The Flamefeather Blossom comes from the south. Its flowers burst open like flaming feathers and are said to burn away evil. It needs a little pest removal and plenty of weeding.

我是境域的維修員，沙漠地帶裝備最容易出問題，有狀況就需要讓專業的維修一下。: I'm the Realm Repairman. Desert travel is hard on your equipment. If anything needs fixing, leave it to a professional!
我是境域的雜物商，在荒瘠的沙漠地帶最需要的就是補給物資，需要就來找我吧!: I'm the Realm Sundries Merchant. Supplies are essential in this barren desert. Come to me whenever you need them!
